source: Weaveworks' microservices-demo architecture (RCAEval's Sock Shop records no traces, so no call was observed directly).

front-end.description: Web UI and API gateway for the browser: calls catalogue, carts, orders and user; keeps sessions in session-db. All user traffic enters here.

catalogue.description: The sock catalogue, stored in catalogue-db.

orders.description: Places orders: reads the customer, address and card from user and the items from carts, has payment authorise the amount, asks shipping to ship; stores orders in orders-db.

payment.description: Authorises payments (mock; declines amounts above a set limit).

user.description: Customer accounts, addresses, cards and login, stored in user-db.

shipping.description: Accepts shipments from orders and publishes them to rabbitmq.

rabbitmq.description: Message queue between shipping and queue-master.

rabbitmq-exporter.description: Exports rabbitmq's metrics; not on the request path.

telemetry_names.istio-init: the Istio sidecar's init container (sets up traffic redirection when a pod starts), not a service

known_noise.pattern: Exception trying to launch/remove worker container ... /var/run/docker.sock
known_noise.note: logged every few seconds before the alert in every RE2-SS and RE3-SS case, with I/O exception and retry lines; the Docker socket is not mounted. Not a symptom by itself.
logged before the alert in every RE2-SS case: carts tries to report traces to a zipkin host that does not exist. Not a symptom by itself.

notes: Sock Shop records no traces in RCAEval; reason about calls from this topology, logs (front-end logs the requests it sends) and metrics.
A load generator (not in the telemetry) drives the traffic through front-end.
